what: A solid line covers only 65% of the circumference from 12 o’clock over a dotted circle, and on hover the remaining 35% joins in .3s ease and closes into a full loop. On release it opens back along the same path — the ”PLAY MOVIE” circle button at the hero center

options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Solid-line circle (svg circle) — uses pathLength when --fx-len is not given="100"
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Closing duration and curve, default .3s · ease
options.--fx-len: Circle circumference 2πr (css variable) — if given, dash values use the same units as the original (r 64 → 402.12). If omitted, pathLength on ring.="100" Attach it to 100

use: PLAY MOVIE

from.where: index.html hero .nm-kv__play (original first_load.css .circle-button: solid-circle stroke-dashoffset 2π·64×.35 → 0, .3s ease, svg rotate(-90deg) · dashed-circle 1 3)
